title: EXP-069-R3 - Hello World Part 4 Section 9: FX_UM Property Class Extension with the Details/Add/Find Right-Click Menu on FX_UMCombobox (replay: commit the extension Right-Click Menu)
objective: Replay of EXP-069-R2, which created the FX_UM property class extension (User version; Add/Details Form FX_UMs, Find Form FX_UMs and Property FX_UM persisted) and cleared the FX_UMCombobox component-level Right-Click Menu, but whose extension Right-Click Menu (StdDetailsAddFind, chosen from the dropdown and confirmed with OK while the combobox still had focus) was blank after the Designer reopen; the editor was left open. Follow hello-world-pt4.md Section 9 (11:04-13:12) on the User-scoped FX_Items Designer Form: set the extension Right-Click Menu to StdDetailsAddFind and commit it with Tab before OK, re-read the extension before the Save, perform one Designer Save, and verify at runtime that right-clicking the Unit of Measure combobox offers Details, Add and Find; choose Details once on dumbbell and verify that the FX_UMs Form opens on EA (Each); close it. Close and reopen the Designer Form once and verify the extension. The component-level Right-Click Menu stays blank, so it inherits from the extension. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt4.md Section 9 (11:04-13:12), the EXP-069-R2 record (T3, T4 and T10 sections) and its final report before browser interaction; read other records only as needed.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-069-R3-hello-world-part-4-section-9-um-property-class-extension-right-click.md and evidence/EXP-069-R3/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection.

Designer baseline: verify the Designer Form is FX_Items in User scope. The FX_UM Property Class Extension editor may still be open from EXP-069-R2 (buttons OK and Help only; Escape does not close it): record whether it is open, its four field values and whether its rows are editable (Right-Click Menu dropdown arrow present or absent), without changing anything. Record FX_UMCombobox Data Source, Inheritance and component-level Right-Click Menu (expected blank). If no Form is loaded, open FX_Items once through the toolbar Open button and Select Form.

Runtime baseline: with the runtime FX_Items Form open (open it once through Form > Open > Select Form if needed), right-click the Unit of Measure combobox once, record the menu items (expected the 25 standard items without Details, Add or Find) with a screenshot, and dismiss with one Escape and, if the menu is still open, one click on blank Form space; never choose an item.

Extension: if the editor is not open, click the FX_UMCombobox Inheritance > Edit Property Class Extensions ellipsis once; it is expected to open directly (if the "does not exist. Create it?" prompt appears instead, answer No once and stop blocked). In the editor, if the Right-Click Menu row is editable: open its dropdown, choose StdDetailsAddFind once, then press Tab once to commit it, and verify that the row shows StdDetailsAddFind as committed text (the combobox no longer active) and that Add/Details Form FX_UMs, Find Form FX_UMs and Property FX_UM are unchanged. Then click OK once and record the response and whether the Designer Save became enabled. If the row is not editable, record the evidence and stop blocked without clicking OK.

Pre-Save readback: click the ellipsis once more and record all four extension fields. If the Right-Click Menu is blank again, stop blocked with the editor open. Otherwise click OK once without changing any field, then perform Designer Save 1 through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim.

Runtime check 1: close the clean runtime FX_Items Form once and reopen it once; right-click the Unit of Measure combobox once; record the menu items verbatim with a screenshot; dismiss as in the baseline.
Never change FX_UMCombobox or any other component: its component-level Right-Click Menu stays blank (cleared and saved by EXP-069-R2). There is no override step.

Cache contingency, only if runtime check 1 does not show Details, Add and Find: invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects once (no runtime Form dirty; close the clean runtime FX_Items Form first), reopen the runtime Form once and right-click once more. Never use the Designer unload.

Drill-down: when the Details/Add/Find menu appears, with dumbbell selected (UM EA), choose Details once; verify the FX_UMs Form opens on the EA record with its description Each; close that FX_UMs Form once (clean, no edits). Never choose Add or Find.

Designer recovery: close the clean FX_Items Designer Form once and reopen it once through the toolbar Open button; click the ellipsis once and verify the four extension settings and the blank component-level Right-Click Menu; close the editor with OK once without changing any field. If that OK makes the Designer dirty, perform Designer Save 2 once and record its response; otherwise make no further Save.

Capture screenshots of the baseline Designer state (with the editor if open), the baseline runtime menu, the committed Right-Click Menu before OK, the pre-Save readback, each Save, each runtime menu, the FX_UMs drill-down and the Designer reopen readback.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; FX_Items in the Designer in User scope; the leftover extension editor state recorded (open or not, four fields, editability); FX_UMCombobox component-level Right-Click Menu blank; the baseline runtime menu recorded. Evidence: Designer and runtime-menu screenshots.

The extension Right-Click Menu set to StdDetailsAddFind and committed with Tab (committed text visible, the other three fields unchanged) before one OK; the response and Save state recorded. Evidence: committed-row and after-OK screenshots.

The pre-Save readback shows StdDetailsAddFind with the other three fields; one no-change OK; Designer Save 1 with the native response verbatim; runtime check 1 after one runtime close/reopen with the menu items recorded. Evidence: readback, Save and menu screenshots.
No component changed (the component-level Right-Click Menu stays blank); the contingency unload used at most once and only under its condition. Evidence: readbacks and the unload count.
The Details/Add/Find menu appears at runtime, and Details on dumbbell opens the FX_UMs Form on EA (Each); that Form closed clean. Evidence: menu and drill-down screenshots.

The clean Designer Form closed once and reopened once; one ellipsis readback shows the four extension settings including StdDetailsAddFind and the blank component-level Right-Click Menu; the editor closed with one no-change OK; Save 2 only if that OK made the Form dirty. Evidence: reopen and readback screenshots.

No other change: no other component, property, class, extension, record or object changed; no Designer unload; no Add or Find used; no dialog or menu left open. Evidence: the audit and final screenshots.

The final EXP-069-R3 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-7, the complete action audit with exact counts (zero extension creations, one extension field change, at most two Designer Saves, runtime close/reopen count, right-click count, at most one Web Client unload, one Details drill-down, OK count, one Designer close/reopen, zero other changes, re-login count), the negative/positive inheritance observation, the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
